    Reduction to a single summand (Lemma 5.3) #

    If an interval representation is a quotient of a direct sum Y₁ ⊞ Y₂, it is a quotient of Y₁ or of Y₂; dually for subobjects. The proof uses that the subobjects of an interval are totally ordered: the image of biprod.desc f g is the sum of the images of f and g, hence the larger of the two, and the kernel of biprod.lift f g is the intersection of the kernels, hence the smaller of the two.
